scenario_boundary: GIGA 2800 is an extreme long-term infrastructure/category-standard hypothesis, not current valuation, forecast, capital ask or revenue claim.
promotion_rule: No premise may be upgraded without an inspectable evidence pointer. Agent output, technical PASS or activity volume cannot substitute for the premise-specific evidence.

premises.name: Category Standard
premises.claim: Third parties choose 4PLANET identities, contracts, APIs, proof grammar or interfaces because they are more useful than fragmented alternatives.
premises.limitations: No third-party dependency or standard adoption has been proven.
premises.falsifier: Relevant external actors consistently prefer their existing fragmented systems or 4PLANET contracts fail interoperability/usefulness tests.
premises.next_strongest_experiment: After internal repeatability, expose one stable bounded contract to an authorised third-party pilot and measure actual use/reuse.

premises.name: Global Trusted Intelligence
premises.claim: Shared Planet Engine truth/provenance can support inspectable multi-source intelligence without collapsing evidence states.
evidence: Browser Product Proof run 33926002221 SUCCESS
Living Learning Loop run 33926002254 SUCCESS
ATLAS Zero Loss run 33926002238 SUCCESS
premises.limitations: Current evidence proves controlled product/source behaviour, not global coverage, institutional decision quality or scientific authority.
premises.falsifier: Material source-state collapse, repeated unsupported claims, inability to transfer source contracts across materially different cases or real users cannot use the intelligence for decisions.
premises.next_strongest_experiment: Complete one independently useful Planet Proof and a materially different transfer case with measured reuse and source-quality preservation.

premises.name: Repeat Human Utility
premises.claim: Embla/4SAPIEN repeatedly improves real human decisions enough that people voluntarily return.
evidence: Embla decision-first prototype on HEIR 80446464d94b6fed4541072296d756f978f99fd5
Existing local Human Proof instrument /labs/food-user-test
premises.limitations: No real participant decision record has yet established human value; automated and fixture tests do not count.
premises.falsifier: Real participants do not gain useful decision clarity/value, cannot understand refusals/UNKNOWN, or do not want to use the system again.
premises.next_strongest_experiment: Run PROOF-H01 with an actual participant, real FOOD decision and real product; capture decision effect, usefulness, trust, comprehension, UNKNOWN clarity and repeat intent.

premises.name: Institutional Utility
premises.claim: Companies, governments, researchers, field actors or funders receive measurable operational/decision value from 4PLANET.
evidence: ORCA relationship and active technical/product dialogue exist, but no institutional utility outcome has been accepted as proof
premises.limitations: Relationship, interest or dialogue is not institutional value proof.
premises.falsifier: Institutions cannot identify a decision/job made materially better or refuse to adopt/pay/use after bounded pilots.
premises.next_strongest_experiment: Convert one existing ORCA/Planet/Action case into a bounded institutional job with an observable before/after outcome.

premises.name: Action / Allocation Throughput
premises.claim: 4PLANET can connect a legitimate need to expert action, suitable capital, delivery proof and learning without collapsing states.
evidence: Gmail message 1a06d1e2ac3b87dc: ORCA confirms 10-12 Portsmouth-Santander surveys and 40-48 survey days in 2026
Gmail message 1a03347c8595d248: ORCA identifies reportable delivery metrics; sponsorship figures explicitly placeholders
Prepared unsent ORCA clarification draft underlying message 1a06e884af72c9bb
premises.limitations: Current actual funding terms, exact funded quantity, commitment, payment and completed funded delivery remain unresolved. Survey delivery is not ecological outcome.
premises.falsifier: No defensible funding unit can be defined, no suitable capital path emerges, or delivery/proof cannot be independently inspected.
premises.next_strongest_experiment: Founder-released clarification to ORCA, then bind current terms to one exact Action Contract and qualified capital path.

premises.name: Proof Moat
premises.claim: 4PLANET truth/provenance/state discipline makes claims more inspectable and safer than vague delivery/impact reporting.
evidence: Gold contract on HEIR separates UNKNOWN and unsupported rankings
Error-to-Immunity register IMM-002 records browser-detected Oslofjord alias loss and forward restoration
State law preserves RECOMMENDED != CHOSEN != EXECUTED != DELIVERED != OUTCOME != VERIFIED IMPACT
premises.limitations: Internal control quality is not yet market trust or a defensible external moat.
premises.falsifier: External users do not value the provenance/state distinction, or controls repeatedly allow unsupported claims into accepted outputs.
premises.next_strongest_experiment: Use one real Action Contract and one real human decision record to test whether proof-state visibility materially improves trust/decision quality.

premises.name: Compounding Infrastructure
premises.claim: New capabilities and learnings improve multiple worlds and make the next accepted proof cheaper/faster without proportional regression cost.
evidence: Embla transfer reused existing FOOD/PICK truth infrastructure rather than restarting
Oslofjord alias failure produced a reusable preservation rule and Error-to-Immunity record
Shared exact-SHA gates validate multiple product surfaces on one HEIR
premises.limitations: Reuse exists, but transfer cost reduction has not yet been quantified against a comparable second proof.
premises.falsifier: Proof 02 requires roughly the same bespoke effort as Proof 01 or shared primitives create equal/greater regression cost.
premises.next_strongest_experiment: Measure reference-to-transfer cost and reuse on one materially different Planet/System proof.

premises.name: AI-native Foundry Economics
premises.claim: Factory/SUPERBRAIN can reduce time, founder burden and marginal production cost while maintaining or improving quality/reliability.
evidence: Current AXE execution rehydrated authority, reconciled stale donor value, used deterministic CI falsifiers and propagated one regression into immunity
Exact-SHA HEIR 80446464d94b6fed4541072296d756f978f99fd5 passed all major product falsifiers before the next mutation
premises.limitations: No robust before/after cost baseline or repeated production economics is established.
premises.falsifier: Automation increases errors, correction cycles or Founder intervention faster than accepted proof throughput improves.
premises.next_strongest_experiment: Record time-to-proof, first-pass rate, correction cycles, reused primitives and Founder actions for this Reality Proof mutation and compare against the next transfer.

premises.name: Global Replication
premises.claim: Shared architecture can transfer across species, places and human systems with materially less work than the first case.
evidence: Oslofjord Planet Proof infrastructure exists on HEIR
Great Barrier Reef is seeded as a materially different transfer pack; Amazonia remains another transfer class
premises.limitations: Seeded transfer is not measured replication and no accepted transfer ratio is established.
premises.falsifier: Materially different cases require bespoke rebuilds or lose truth/quality when reused.
premises.next_strongest_experiment: Complete one materially different transfer and quantify new vs reused primitives, sources, tests, defects, time and Founder burden.

premises.name: Durable Economic Capture
premises.claim: 4PLANET can retain a defensible share of the value it creates through repeatable products/contracts/intelligence/platform economics without damaging trust or mission.
evidence: ORCA has discussed sponsorship structure, but stated presented amounts were placeholders
Human Proof instrument records payment intent as research signal only
premises.limitations: No current proposal, commitment, contract/award, revenue or cash from the GIGA proof loops is established.
premises.falsifier: Users/institutions value the system but will not pay/fund, capture mechanisms damage trust, or economics require disproportionate founder/service labour.
premises.next_strongest_experiment: Generate one bounded source-backed economic proposition from accepted proof and advance it through TARGET -> INTEREST -> PROPOSAL -> COMMITMENT -> CONTRACT/AWARD -> CASH without collapsing states.
